decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The window in the first floor eastern side elevation of the main dwellinghouse (serving a bathroom) shall: (a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the first floor rear extension element of the development or flank elevation of the main dwelling hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</span></p>
